title: Incognito Chat
description: Incognito Chat is a client-side Minecraft mod that adds private encrypted chat, custom groups, and secure communication between players.
body:
# Incognito Chat

> Private encrypted communication for Minecraft.

**Incognito Chat** is a client-side Minecraft mod that adds private encrypted communication between players.
Create your own groups, use unique encryption codes, and securely chat with your friends directly in-game.

---

## Features

* Private encrypted chat
* 3 separate group slots
* Unique encryption code for each group
* Fast group switching
* Player invitation system
* Custom text colors
* Customizable menu keybind
* Client-side mod

---

## How It Works

Each group uses its own encryption code that **you choose**.

Players with the same code and selected group can read encrypted messages.

---

## Usage

After installing the mod:

1. Join any world or server
2. Open the **ESC** menu

You will see new buttons:

### #1, #2, #3

Quickly switch between groups.

### Enable/Disable Encrypting

Enable or disable encryption.

### Incognito Settings

Main settings menu of the mod.

Inside the settings menu you can:

* switch between groups;
* change your **encryption code**;
* invite players;
* change your text color.

---

## Hotkey

By default, **Incognito Settings** can be opened with the **N** key.

You can change the keybind here:

> **Controls → Multiplayer → Open Incognito Settings**
